interview.name: Nell
interview.answer: The repair drive is coming up soon, but no time or location is specified in these notes.

events.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive is coming up, but I’m still catching up on the details. What should I know?
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Rosa: Sure thing — we’re gathering tools and supplies for small home repairs, and folks can drop off or request help at the community center this week. I’ll make sure you get the schedule and sign-up details.
events.speaker: Rosa

events.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — I’d appreciate that. I’ll keep an eye out for the schedule and sign-up details.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Quinn: I’m thinking we should get the repair drive moving soon — I can spread the word to a few neighbors if you want.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Nell: That’d be great — I’ve mostly been hearing bits and pieces, so a little help spreading the word would really help.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll tell a few folks today and make sure they know the details.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Nell: I’m still a bit behind on the details, so I’d appreciate a quick rundown. If you’re spreading the word, I can help by passing it along once I know what to say.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll send over a quick rundown of the repair drive so you can pass it along. I’ll also check who’s available and what tasks still need doing.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Nell: Thanks, that would help a lot. Once you send the rundown, I’ll pass it along to a few neighbors I’ve been catching up with.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Uli: Tell me the time and what needs fixing, and I’ll be there. If you want, I can also check the exact location for you.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Nell: Thanks — I’m still piecing it together, so the location and schedule would help a lot. If you can send me the exact details, I’ll pass them along.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Uli: I’ll check the exact location and let you know. For now, I just know Dane said he’ll be there around 3:30 to help with the loose fence panel.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Gus: Sure thing, Nell — I’ve got a hammer, screwdriver, and wrench you can borrow for the repair drive. Just swing by and let me know what you need.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Nell: Thanks, Gus — that’s really helpful. I’m still catching up on the repair drive details, so I’ll swing by and ask what else I should know.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Gus: No rush at all — just stop by when you’re ready, and I’ll fill you in and hand over any tools you need.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Eli: Good, let’s keep it simple: tell me the time, the location, and what still needs fixing. Then I can help get the list sorted.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Nell: I’m still catching up on the details, but I can swing by and get the time and location, plus what’s left to fix. Then I’ll pass it along so you can help sort the list.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Eli: That works for me, Nell. Once you have the time, location, and the fix list, send it over and I’ll help sort it out.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still on and going well — folks have been dropping things off all afternoon at the community center parking lot. I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if anything changes.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Nell: Thanks, Tess — I’m still catching up, so I’ll pass that along. Let me know if you hear what folks still need help with.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Tess: Sure thing, Nell — I’ve got a hammer and some screwdrivers you can borrow for the repair drive. Just swing by and I’ll hand them over.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Nell: I’m still catching up, but I heard the repair drive is coming up soon. If you need help spreading the word, I can do that too.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Faye: I’ve been meaning to check what still needs doing. Just tell me the time and any remaining fixes, and I’ll keep to the plan.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Nell: That would help a lot—spreading the updated details is probably the biggest need right now. If you can also keep a few spots open for volunteers on Sunday, I’d really appreciate it.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Nell: That still works for me — late morning is best. Can you send the exact tools and replacement parts list so I know what we’re missing?
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Rey: Sure — I’ll send over the tools and replacement parts list. Thanks for keeping it easy, Nell.
events.speaker: Rey

prov.value: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.

events.text: Nell: Perfect, thanks — I’m still catching up, so that’ll help a lot. I’ll keep an eye out for it and get ready for late morning.
events.speaker: Nell
